assumptions.text: The percentage 46.5% is the empirical ratio of albino offspring observed in the cross.

constraints.source_ref: 46.5% of the offspring completely lacked pigment ( n = 40/86 )

source_mapping.quote: 46.5% of the offspring completely lacked pigment ( n = 40/86, Supplementary Fig. 5j )

unresolved.question: The passage claims a change in the oca2 locus is responsible for albinism, but no mathematical mechanism for the genetic inheritance or the biochemical pathway is provided.
The value 46.5% (40/86) is approximately 0.4651; the passage rounds this to one decimal place.
